parallel.requirements: The parent recognized exact byte-for-byte CLI behavior, Python float repr, argparse edge cases, bytes repr output, ESM .mjs files, no external dependencies, and black-box executable probing.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent retained implementation ownership but delegated behavioral discovery to a workflow with four initial probes and three adversarial verifier hunters after a probe barrier.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote multiple ESM modules for unicode handling, Python-style float parsing and repr, argparse, canonicaljson encoding, runtime argv/stdout/stderr, traceback behavior, and /output/test3.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent wrote all final /output sources itself and the artifact validator copied a complete output tree, including test3.mjs and library modules.
parallel.verification: The parent ran smoke tests, a curated differential suite that first found mismatches then reached 200/200, and started a 4000-case fuzz run, while delegated adversarial verification was incomplete.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow ended killed with null result, one adversarial child error, and two adversarial children in progress; the background fuzz was killed and the official result failed one of 148 samples.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same exact CLI, output, ESM, no-dependency, and black-box executable requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial run had no delegation; the single agent owned probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery.
serial.implementation: The serial implementation wrote ESM modules for Python exceptions, repr(str), repr(bytes), float parsing and repr, canonicaljson encoding, argparse behavior, and the test3.mjs entry point.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial output tree was assembled as one coherent artifact with test3.mjs and local libraries, and artifact validation copied the expected entry point and modules.
serial.verification: The serial agent completed a 331/331 behavioral differential suite, a 1066/1066 numeric-formatting sweep, and a final byte scan before final response.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished workflow or process failure is visible; the agent exited normally and the current official evaluator result is 148/148.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the core requirements for ESM, manual argv, exact float/output behavior, and black-box probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and recognized the same output, CLI, ESM, and probing requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement misunderstanding is shown; the difference came from completing and acting on verification rather than from different stated requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral discovery into four probe children and three adversarial verifier children, while the parent retained implementation ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial disabled workflows and control tools, so one agent owned the whole probe, implement, test, and deliver path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel split created a verifier scope that later failed/aborted; the serial run had no delegated verifier lifecycle to recover.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed and the adversarial phase was explicitly given the combined probe spec, so the evidence does not show a missing brief or interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept context local and encoded learned facts directly into its modules and test harnesses.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material interface issue was lifecycle failure after delegation, not missing task context: the adversarial verifier work did not return complete results to be consumed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote the entry point and supporting modules, including argparse, canonicaljson, Python float parsing/repr, bytes repr, runtime argv, stdio, and traceback helpers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a smaller but analogous set of ESM modules for argparse, Python float formatting, bytes/string repr, canonicaljson, and test3.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both produced plausible implementations; the known concrete divergence is that the parallel artifact still missed one official case while the serial artifact passed all official cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow's aggregate result is null and the saved state is killed after a failed adversarial child and in-progress adversarial children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle; local verification results were observed and included in the final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left required delegated verifier work unresolved, while serial consumed its own verification results before final delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent wrote the final output files and artifact validation copied a coherent tree; no child write collision into the deliverable is evidenced.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial assembled a single coherent output tree with test3.mjs and local library modules, and artifact validation accepted it.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Integration was not the differentiating failure; the differentiator was incomplete validation/takeover rather than write collision or artifact assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reached a 200/200 curated local differential suite but started a deeper fuzz run that was later killed; the delegated adversarial verifier phase also never completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed both final behavioral and numeric sweeps, reporting 331/331 and 1066/1066 matched before final output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger completed acceptance evidence; parallel's incomplete adversarial and fuzz verification left an edge-case gap consistent with the one official miss.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full budget, received returncode 143, timed out, and produced no final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial exited with returncode 0, did not time out, and had remaining budget after the agent completed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed under timeout with unresolved verifier/fuzz work; serial closed normally after completed verification and final answer.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations make this a serial_only_pass pair: parallel passed 147/148 and serial passed 148/148. The visible process difference is not that parallel failed to build an artifact; it did. The difference is that parallel delegated adversarial verification, that verifier phase failed/was killed with unfinished children, and the parent did not take that scope over before timeout. Serial kept the work local, completed broader differential and numeric verification, and delivered a passing artifact.
parallel_contributors: The adversarial verifier workflow was planned as a required second phase but ended with null result, killed status, one 429 child error, and two in-progress adversarial children.
The parent timed out with a killed background fuzz run and no final response, leaving verification closure incomplete.
The artifact was close but still missed one official sample, consistent with incomplete edge-case verification.
serial_contributors: Serial completed a 331/331 behavioral differential suite and a 1066/1066 numeric-formatting sweep before final delivery.
Serial exited normally with workflows disabled and passed all 148 official samples.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The exact hidden failing input for the parallel artifact is not present in the pair evidence, so the one-sample miss is recorded as an implementation or coverage gap rather than assigned to a guessed code defect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause

candidates.reason: The parent clearly owned and wrote the implementation files; child work was probing and verification support, not the only implementation owner.
There were no separately owned implementation components requiring an unassigned integrator; the parent assembled the final output tree.
The parent created /output/test3.mjs and supporting modules, and artifact validation found the expected entry point.
The parent owned the end-to-end implementation, testing, and delivery path; the failure was an unresolved verifier failure chain, not an ownerless pipeline.
The parent did not block all productive work behind a mandatory preflight; it probed, implemented, and tested while the workflow was running.
Although the workflow had a probe barrier before adversarial hunting, productive parent implementation proceeded concurrently and the retained failure is the aborted verifier lifecycle.
The indispensable implementation path was not visibly starved of all capacity; the parent kept implementing and testing until timeout.
Parallel fan-out and token use are visible, but the directly evidenced boundary is a failed/aborted verifier scope with no takeover, not a separate collective breadth exhaustion episode.
The child scopes were specific probes or adversarial lenses; no single child was shown to be overbroad relative to siblings and to leave indispensable work unfinished for that reason.
The workflow briefs included the executable, black-box rule, stdout/stderr/exit capture, and detailed behavioral areas; no known parent requirement was omitted from a child brief.
Children produced observations rather than independently owned code components, so no missing cross-agent file, export, or interface contract caused incompatible integration.
The completed probe findings were aggregated into a spec digest; the evidence does not show a known finding disappearing through transfer.
The combined spec was large, but there is no completed handoff that the parent demonstrably received and could not reduce in time.
No handoff consumed by the parent or a child is shown to describe a superseded workspace, requirement, or decision state.
No incompatible completed reports or contracts are shown arriving and remaining unadjudicated at a decision point.
The parallel run did not make a normal whole-task completion decision; its final response is empty and the visible gap is unfinished verifier work, not unsupported acceptance.
The argparse probe retry completed and returned structured output; there is no evidence that a replacement repeated work without checkpointed findings and caused the final gap.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel workflow explicitly launched an adversarial verifier phase after the probe phase, but the workflow was killed with a null result, a 429 error in `hunt:argparse-corners`, and other adversarial hunters still in progress. The parent did not resume, reassign, or complete that verifier scope before timeout, while serial completed stronger local verification and passed.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel run closed with unfinished adversarial verification and weaker acceptance coverage, and its final artifact failed one official sample.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The nearest timing label is wrong because no completed adversarial verifier finding was trapped below the parent; the verifier work failed or remained in progress and needed takeover.
